diff --git a/tests/test_repair_deletion_tracking.py b/tests/test_repair_deletion_tracking.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repair_deletion_tracking.py
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+import difflib
+import unittest
+from datetime import datetime
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import rs_parsepatch
+
+from bugbug import repository
+
+
+SHORT = (
+    'int process(int x) {\n    return x;\n}\n\n'
+    'int untouched() {\n    return 99;\n}\n'
+)
+LONG = (
+    'int process(int x) {\n    int temporary = x + 1;\n'
+    '    temporary += 2;\n    temporary *= 3;\n'
+    '    temporary -= 4;\n    return x;\n}\n\n'
+    'int untouched() {\n    return 99;\n}\n'
+)
+
+
+class DeletionTrackingTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def mine(self, before, after, spans):
+        change = 'diff --git a/change.cpp b/change.cpp\n' + ''.join(
+            difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(True), after.splitlines(True),
+                                 fromfile='a/change.cpp', tofile='b/change.cpp')
+        )
+        commit = repository.Commit(
+            node='synthetic-commit', author='test', desc='edit process only',
+            date=datetime(2020, 1, 1), pushdate=datetime(2020, 1, 1),
+            bug_id=1, backedoutby='', author_email='test@example.invalid', reviewers=[],
+        )
+        hg = Mock()
+        hg.rawcommand.return_value = b'change.cpp\x00\x00'
+        hg.export.return_value = change.encode('utf-8')
+        hg.cat.return_value = after.encode('utf-8')
+        analyzer = Mock()
+        analyzer.function.return_value = {'spans': [
+            {'name': name, 'start_line': start, 'end_line': end, 'error': False}
+            for name, start, end in spans
+        ]}
+        # Only repository I/O and the external analysis service are fixtures.
+        # The real diff parser, transform and coordinate mapping execute.
+        with patch.object(repository, 'HG', hg, create=True), patch.object(
+            repository, 'code_analysis_server', analyzer, create=True
+        ), patch.object(
+            repository, 'rs_parsepatch', rs_parsepatch, create=True
+        ), patch.object(repository, 'path_to_component', {}):
+            return repository._transform(commit)
+
+    def test_deletion_does_not_mark_the_shifted_untouched_function(self):
+        result = self.mine(LONG, SHORT, [('process', 1, 3), ('untouched', 5, 7)])
+        self.assertEqual(set(map(tuple, result.functions['change.cpp'])), {('process', 1, 3)})
+
+    def test_addition_still_marks_the_changed_function(self):
+        result = self.mine(SHORT, LONG, [('process', 1, 7), ('untouched', 9, 11)])
+        self.assertEqual(set(map(tuple, result.functions['change.cpp'])), {('process', 1, 7)})
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)

  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
python -m unittest tests/test_repair_deletion_tracking.py
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
